summary: Accepted the secure packaged native shell, actual project baseline and persisted five-stage navigation, focused settings/inspector layout, lifecycle recovery, keyboard/scaling and bounded real reader output. Timestamps cover the final acceptance window; earlier reviewed slice evidence is retained separately. Later editor, Codex, capture and user-video acceptance remain required.

checks.name: Secure packaged window and actual project navigation
checks.command_or_method: Playwright Electron inside isolated Linux Docker: packaged local protocol/CSP, sandbox/preload/sender boundary; all five stages persist; actual baseline/source/frame preservation, failed-save preservation and reopen.

checks.name: Packaged lifecycle and recovery
checks.command_or_method: Real packaged startup failure, missing assets, normal shutdown, second instance, process kill/reopen, corrupt preferences and one explicit renderer reopen; subsequent crash closes.

checks.name: Keyboard, scale and restrained visual behavior
checks.command_or_method: Packaged 100/125/150/200 percent checks, modal isolation/focus, one panel, contrast, non-color selection and emulated forced-colors/reduced-motion; guest-only input independently inspected full window at100/200 percent and Next frame.

checks.name: Real screen-reader control output
checks.command_or_method: Natural Orca50.2/AT-SPI2.56.8 activation; seven genuine braille-output events paired with app-owned focus, settings API readback, immutable fixture and committed Edit UI/disk assertions; parent whole-guest screenshot inspection.

checks.name: Source validation and spec synchronization
checks.command_or_method: Full npm run check:37 Python/44 TypeScript tests,28 schema pairs,20 reference images,10 invalid quality-contract rejections; final harness typecheck/lint/format and guest run. Source/contract review and staged privacy audit.

checks.name: Reviewed public source and CI
checks.command_or_method: Verified public owner/remote, reviewed slice commit, Windows/Linux CI and remote revision.

known_limits: P2-P10 remain required. No real Codex login/edit, recorder, complete editor, continuous A/V preview, audio listening, final export or user-example edit is accepted.
Native tests are synthetic Linux Docker runs with no host UI control. Windows screen-reader, hardware capture, installer, signing and OS media-preference integration remain unverified.

Orca43.1 missed-announcement failures are retained. Orca50.2 smoke covers seven controls via actual braille monitor output, not speech, physical braille, every error announcement or full accessibility certification.

Earlier native startup and five-second pending-save timeouts remain unexplained. The final reader run passed with a bounded30-second commit wait and on-disk assertion; this does not establish the earlier timeout cause.
Edit-focus screenshot shows a subsequent Orca mode announcement and precedes stage activation; committed stage is verified separately by the test.
Source preview equality covers bounded opaque BGRA fixture canvas samples; arbitrary alpha, display compositing, production rendering and master fidelity remain outside P1.

Provenance consolidates older lifecycle/test artifacts retrospectively; test formatting differences and package metadata differences are disclosed. Private artifacts remain local and are not published.

The first PR10 Linux CI attempt was cancelled after ten minutes in FFmpeg dependency installation. Retained logs subsequently showed slow package downloads, not a proven hang. The unchanged retry is recorded separately; cancellation is not counted as a pass.

changed: ADR0013 actual project foundation; architecture, Home/project screens, import/project/data/revision specs, typed project and preferences IPC, examples, tests, P1 prompt, tasks and traceability.
Persisted100-200percent settings, single inspector/modal focus, native asset/startup failure and bounded recovery requirements; keyboard/contrast/media-preference checks.
Native-testing skills/routing and guest-only input boundary; reproducible pinned test-only reader provisioning, exact runtime/output provenance, notices and publication privacy checks.
Documentation resource organization and synchronized live references; editorial first-cut requirements and suggestion validation published separately for later phases.
unchanged: Immutable media, lossless capture/intermediate/master policy, domain edit operations and future shared transaction requirement.
Codex-only genuine runtime, shared undo, explicit final export/deletion/cleanup/spending/publication controls; no fabricated AI or stage-execution claims.
Reference image bytes and correction notes; no bundled third-party production assets or private evidence.
P3-P10 full acceptance despite the minimum project foundation brought into P1.
